page.notes: Right part of the page is cut off, so the page numbers of the first entries and some words are incomplete ("Regũ", "vo", "con-", "Conci-", "admi-", "parlamen-", "Re-", "imma-") and are copied only as far as visible. Initial "A" and the ornamental capitals are printed as shown. Some page numbers are partly lost at the edge; "ibi." and "213" are read as printed. The top of the page is cut off at the left, so the heading line and several entries are cut short at their beginnings. The entry "Budæus" at the foot is set in a larger italic type. Some numerals and letters are partly broken, so the readings "Blanca" and "Bonifacij" are not fully certain; the numerals "201," and "148" may also be misread.
